We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now we're expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Forward Deployment Engineer - Spanish (m/f/d) Your Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer for our Spanish market, you work directly at the intersection of product and customer setups. You capture requirements, translate them into robust implementations, and take fonio live at customers - including integrations, automations, and ongoing optimization.

You work closely with Product/Engineering and Go-to-Market, making sure deployments are fast, stable, and repeatable across the Spanish market.

What you'll do

º Capture customer requirements and translate them into concrete implementation plans

º Build and roll out fonio setups in production: workflows, logic, prompts, guardrails

º Implement integrations with third-party systems (APIs, webhooks, CRM, calendar, ticketing, etc.)

º Develop smaller features and glue code to cleanly map customer cases

º Debug under production conditions: calls, flows, edge cases, fast fixes

º Build reusable templates and deployment playbooks to make setups scalable

º Deliver product feedback: bring pain points and feature gaps to the team, prioritized and concrete

Who we're looking for

º Solid coding skills: you can implement independently, not just configure

º Strong understanding of AI systems and LLMs (prompting, tool-use, RAG, failure modes)

º Workflow thinking: translate complex processes into robust, testable flows

º Experience with APIs, webhooks, auth, and common integration patterns

º Cloud fundamentals: deployments, observability, debugging in production

º Highly pragmatic working style: ship fast, make it stable, iterate

º Bonus: Voice/Telephony, n8n, TypeScript/Python, SQL, monitoring/tracing, GDPR

º Spanish at native or near-native level + solid English

What we offer

º Competitive salary: €60,000-€95,000 per year

º 100% Focus Time (no regular meetings)

º Unlimited budget when the ROI is right

º Extreme speed (we ship almost daily)

º Thousands of enthusiastic customers building the product together with us

Hiring Process

 * 25 min intro

 * 30 min deep dive with CTO & Co-Founder Matthias

 * 20 min culture fit with one of our founders

How we hire?

We're AI-native, including in hiring. AI helps us to remain efficient, but people make every decision.

fonio is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for talent and ownership, whatever your background is.

Need an adjustment in the process? Just tell us.

Please send your CV in English. Then knock us off our feet ¿

Join one of Europe¿s fastest-growing companies. 1 Content Creator (Dutch) (m/w/d) Your Role

You are the face of fonio. You get in front of the camera, explain AI in a way that gets people excited, and build both brand and conversions at the same time. The challenge: we're B2B, but we want to build ourselves like a consumer brand.

 

What You'll Do

 * Regularly produce content for TikTok and Instagram: short, entertaining videos about AI, automation, and our products

 * Contribute ideas, help develop formats, and understand what performs

 * Think brand and conversion together: you know that great content can do both

 * Work closely with our Creative Strategist

 

Who We're Looking For

 * You feel at home in front of the camera and you're entertaining on it

 * You're excited about AI and the whole space, not just casually interested

 * Native-level Dutch + good English skills

 

What We Offer

 * Competitive salary: €45,000-€60,000

 * Equity: you're helping build this, so you should get a piece of it

 * Equipment of your choice: whatever makes you happy

 * Lunch & dinner on us: We cover your lunch and dinner every day, plus unlimited drinks and snacks.

 

How to apply

Film a 30-60 second vertical video (TikTok/Reels style) in your native language that would make a small business owner, like a hairdresser, plumber or dentist, want to try an AI phone assistant like fonio. Your phone is all you need. Applications without a video won't be considered.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Financial Accountant (m/f/d) The role

You make sure Fonio's numbers are right and can stand up to auditors and investors. That means owning the monthly and year-end close, and solving tricky questions such as how to account for pay-per-minute revenue across nine markets and more.

As new entities and products launch, you set up the accounting so it scales, rather than patching it later.

What to Expect

 * In-house accounting: Take over accounting from our external provider and build the internal function.

 * Operational ownership: Own day-to-day accounting, including AP/AR, reconciliations, master data and bookkeeping.

 * Monthly close & reporting: Own monthly closing and recurring statutory filings (VAT, ZM, Intrastat, etc.), working closely with our tax advisors.

 * Revenue recognition: make sure usage-based revenue is recognised correctly and consistently.

 * Multi-entity: run intercompany accounting, currencies and consolidation as UK and US entities come online, and integrate acquisitions such as fluently.

 * Controls and policies: write accounting policies and controls that hold up in investor due diligence.

 * Oversight: keep billing, payables and payroll postings accurate, and improve processes and systems as volume grows.

What You Bring

Must-haves

 * 4 to 7 years in accounting, ideally with audit firm training plus time at a tech or SaaS company.

 * Qualified or part-qualified (Bilanzbuchhalter, ACCA, CPA or similar).

 * Has owned month-end and year-end close and statutory accounts under Austrian GAAP (UGB).

 * Confident handling audits and technical accounting questions.

 * Fluent in English.

Nice-to-haves

 * Revenue recognition for subscription or usage-based pricing.

 * Multi-entity consolidation, or IFRS exposure.

 * Experience with post-merger integration or investor due diligence.

 * Familiar with modern finance tools (e.g. BMD, DATEV, Xero or Stripe).

What We Offer

 * €65,000 to €100,000 + Equity

 * Relocation support

 * Daily lunch and dinner

 * Equipment of your choice

 * Regular team off-sites

 * On-site in Vienna, working directly with the core-team

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 20 min culture fit
